title: Law to speed up permits for new businesses
summary: This bill would require the mayor to set up a program coordinating inspections and plan reviews across city agencies to shorten the time it takes to open a new business, including child care programs and restaurants. The mayor could set eligibility or priority criteria such as business location, type, size or ownership history, and must create an online application portal. Starting December 31, 2027 and every year after, the mayor must report publicly on the program's effectiveness.
